author: Slidebean
description:
The quiet AI war Mozilla is actually fighting.

Most AI investment is chasing speed, scale, and compute.

Mozilla is chasing trust.

With a billion dollar commitment, Mozilla is organizing a coalition of startups and nonprofits to build the infrastructure AI needs to work in regulated environments.

No flashy models.
No headline grabbing demos.

Just the unglamorous systems required for accountability, privacy, and control.

The question isn’t whether this approach is exciting.
It’s whether open and safe can beat fast and funded before the window closes.

author: Slidebean
description:
Why AI coverage needs fewer answers and better questions.

Wired didn’t try to tell us what AI will become.

They showed us something more revealing:
how differently power, inevitability, and choice are perceived depending on where you stand.

Sometimes the most useful coverage isn’t explanatory.
It’s clarifying what we’re actually arguing about.
